mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months indicates growing demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of the periods following sustained increases in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals increased economic output, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the combination signals a tight monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the previous quarter indicates growing economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of the periods following sustained increases in real GDP.
